scope: Read-only geometric analysis of six failure scans and all 24 same-donor fully recalled scans within the identity-selected CPU panel; no additional inference, no STU input. Geometry associations do not identify a causal model mechanism.

definitions.height: World point minus placement road anchor, projected onto placement local z (road normal).
definitions.surface_normal_abs_vertical: Absolute cosine between the nearest observed mesh triangle normal and road normal: 1 horizontal, 0 vertical.
definitions.mesh_boundary_distance: Euclidean distance to edges incident to exactly one measured donor triangle, including holes; this is observation-support boundary, not necessarily a physical object edge.
definitions.context_anomaly_point_fraction: Number of this inserted donor returns in the 24 non-target angular blocks divided by all actual returns in those blocks, including ignored-label inputs.
definitions.planarity_proxy: Smallest eigenvalue divided by trace for up to 12 nearest observed anomaly returns; low values denote local planar geometry, not semantic normality.
definitions.coordinate_validation: Scored original slot identities and supervised targets rechecked against the unchanged authoritative reader; point-to-observed-mesh distance measures consistency of rendered XYZ and stored donor surface.

findings.cause_sentence: 在这6个失败观测内，漏检集中在靠近正常背景的大物体下部平整表面，而不主要发生于稀疏远距点或实测表面的边缘。
findings.decision: 数据与训练应在既有原尺寸放置规则内补足近处大物体下半部、连续平面与邻近正常点的联合监督；本诊断不支持将全部新增预算只投向远距离或稀疏异常。

findings.cause_sentence: 排除目标角块并没有排除整件异常物体，所有129个漏点的三种尺度邻域都仍包含该物体的其他回波。
findings.counterevidence: 同帧正确检出的异常点也有这一性质，1°邻域异常点占比的FN/TP均值均为0.66919，因而该性质尚不能解释具体漏检点。
findings.decision: 下一版可利用已有原始—插入配对检查并约束正常场在邻域含插入物体时的稳定性；需要枝干输出或受控对照才能认定因果，不应仅凭占比扩大角块或移除正常场。

findings.cause_sentence: 这批漏点的坐标都落在有实测同侧支持的供体表面上，没有出现埋入路面或从缺失背面凭空补点的证据。
findings.decision: 保留当前实测表面重投射与原尺寸放置原则，不能为了清除难例而删除合法下部平面点，也不应把这批模型漏检直接归因于几何生成错误。

findings.cause_sentence: 相同大型垃圾箱供体在相近距离和点数下既可完全检出也可大量漏检，单纯的供体身份或点数不足不能解释失败。
findings.decision: 补充同物体不同视角、不同背景的有效观测，并优先检查下部平面与背景上下文交互；不要只重复同一视角或简单增加每帧点数。

large_dumpster_coverage.scope: The exact first 10000 saved training-order entries (1250 successful updates x effective batch 8), plus immutable full-manifest and planned-order availability. Actual donor surface identities were joined to sequences.json, and all executed large-dumpster positive delta arrays were independently counted and measured.
limitations: Source donor point count is not a generated-return count; observed counts below are obtained separately from manifests and checked against executed positive deltas.
Triangle count and measured mesh area describe retained observation support, not complete object geometry or semantic diversity.
A confirmed coverage gap does not independently prove it causes every false negative; the same validation donor sometimes succeeds under comparable range/count.
Additional training donors must come from the existing training partition; validation donor surfaces must remain excluded.

finding.cause_sentence: 训练实际见到的大型垃圾箱只有两份远距稀疏表面，既没有15米内的观测，也没有单帧50点以上的观测，因而缺少与主要失败样本对应的近处稠密大箱下部平面监督。
finding.evidence: 前10000次训练读取中这两供体合计177帧、1164异常点，最大28点/帧，路面上方1米以内只有83点；全部可用训练数据同样没有15米内或50点以上的大型垃圾箱观测。
finding.decision: 从训练分区重新选取近距离、下部表面完整、回波充足的大型容器供体，再按原尺寸生成近中远距离观测；保留验证实例独立，不移动51b8或e778到训练，也不靠重复当前两个稀疏供体补足缺口。
finding.boundary: 这明确支持大型垃圾箱联合观测条件不足，不能外推为所有异常类别都缺少密集点，也不能独立证明补数据必定消除所有漏检。
